centring_convention_note: rho_centred_* is mean-centring; rho_centred_by_median_* is median-centring. Both are shift-invariant; they differ by ~0.06 because the residual distribution is skewed.

permutation_null.kind: within-assay permutation of observed, residual rebuilt
permutation_null.note: The null exceeds the observed value, because |residual| contains |predicted| by construction. That is why this statistic is withdrawn in either direction.

magnitude_prior_verdict.why: residual = observed - predicted, so |residual| contains |predicted| by construction. The correct null shuffles observed within assay and rebuilds the residual, preserving the construction and destroying only the pairing - and it is LARGER than the observed value. The statistic carries no usable signal about epistasis in either direction, so reporting it with a flipped sign would have been just as wrong as the original.
magnitude_prior_verdict.what_survives: the position effect (H2) and residue identity (H1) in results/depth.json, which have valid nulls; see the README for how far each one actually goes.
